ability.text: After you successfully investigate: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per round.)

elder_sign.text: +1. Search your deck for any Tome, Relic, or Codex asset. Play it for free. Shuffle your deck.

signatures.name: Wisdom of Antiquity
signatures.text: +1 <int> while Wisdom of Antiquity is in play. After Wisdom of Antiquity enters play: Search your deck for a Tome card and draw it. Shuffle your deck. Once per round: After you successfully investigate, you may exhaust Wisdom of Antiquity to investigate again at your location without spending an action.

signatures.name: The Unbroken Codex
signatures.text: You may use your <int> instead of <agi> when evading enemies. After you would be dealt horror from an encounter card or enemy effect: Exhaust The Unbroken Codex — ignore 1 of that horror.

signatures.name: The Collector's Ledger
signatures.text: After you draw a card from your investigator ability: Gain 2 resources.

signatures.name: My Glass is Nearly Run
signatures.text: Attach to Alistair Greystoke. Revelation — Put My Glass is Nearly Run into play in your threat area. At the end of the upkeep phase: Take 1 horror. Spend 3 clues: Discard My Glass is Nearly Run.

signatures.name: The Greystoke Tomb
signatures.text: At the start of the Mythos phase: If you have 4 or more cards in hand, gain 2 resources. If you have 7 or more cards in hand, also heal 1 horror from Alistair Greystoke. If you have 10 or more cards in hand, also heal 1 damage from Alistair Greystoke.

signatures.name: Arkham Scrolls
signatures.text: At the start of your turn: Draw 1 card.

deck.name: The Ancient Binding
deck.text: 3/3 soak. When The Ancient Binding is defeated: Return it to your deck. Shuffle your deck.

deck.name: The Relic Harvester
deck.text: 2/2 soak. After you successfully investigate and discover 1 or more clues: Gain 1 resource. Exhaust: Search top 5 cards of your deck for an asset and draw it.

deck.name: My Eyes and Ears
deck.text: 1/3 soak. After you successfully investigate: Discover 1 additional clue at your location. When defeated: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.

deck.name: The Summoner's Deck
deck.text: You have 1 additional ally slot. May have 2 unique Ally assets in play simultaneously. After an Ally is defeated: Exhaust — shuffle that Ally into deck instead of discarding.

deck.name: Arkham's Ring
deck.text: Exhaust Arkham's Ring: You get +2 <com> until the end of the round.

deck.name: Deduction
deck.text: If successful while investigating: Discover 1 additional clue at that location.

deck.name: Perception
deck.text: Max 1 per test. If successful: Draw 1 card.

deck.name: Crack the Case
deck.text: Fast. Play after investigator discovers last clue at your location. Each investigator at your location gains 1 resource per point of that location's shroud value.

deck.name: Working a Hunch
deck.text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Discover 1 clue at your location.

deck.name: Drawn to the Flame
deck.text: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.

deck.name: Mind Over Matter
deck.text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Until end of round, you may use <int> in place of <com> and <agi>.

deck.name: Ward of Protection
deck.text: Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card. Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

deck.name: Fearless
deck.text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror.

deck.name: Evidence
deck.text: Play after an enemy is defeated at your location. Discover 1 clue at your location.

deck.name: Guts
deck.text: Max 1 per test. If successful: Draw 1 card.

deck.name: Inquiring Mind
deck.text: Commit to a skill test only if there is a clue at your location.
